notes: DECISION: the current file (and postiz.com's marketing SVG, and the repo's logo-text.svg) draws a white card with the p cut out, which disappears on light backgrounds. The Postiz app's own Logo component draws the same mark with a #131019 outline round the white card and a filled #131019 p, so it reads on both themes as one file (sheet checked: card and p clear on dark and light). icon_check still reports vanishes-light 55% (the white card's inside, which the outline bounds) and vanishes-dark 10% (the dark outline, with the white card still showing); I judged both fine by eye. If the reviewer wants the marketing look in dark mode, the current staging file can serve as postiz-dark.svg.
